name: How long does it take to install a new bathroom countertop?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new bathroom countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bathroom countertop installations take between two to four hours on the day of placement, assuming the vanity base is already secured and level. However, the full timeline includes measuring, templating, and custom stone fabrication, which typically adds one to three weeks prior to install day. If your remodel involves removing an old tiled or glued top, minor drywall repairs or cabinet shimming may add an extra hour. After the slab is set, plumbing reconnections usually wait 24 hours so adhesives and silicone fully cure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Physical installation usually takes 2 to 4 hours. Fabrication beforehand takes 1 to 3 weeks, and plumbing typically reconnects 24 hours later to allow adhesives to cure.
